pull_request.title: Tracker: establish Gen3 truth-tracking baseline with Geant4 and Fatras
pull_request.head: codex/tracker-truth-baseline
pull_request.body:
Establish an ideal-field **3 T** truth-associated ACTS Kalman baseline for the exact Gen3 nODD tracker and material map merged in PR100. Compare Geant4 and Fatras using one muon per event at fixed pT 1, 10 and 100 GeV, geometric 50×50 µm pixels, 75 µm×0.5 mm short-strip cells, and 80 µm one-coordinate long strips on the actual stereo faces.

This draft contains the reproducible native chain, configuration, analytic controls, independent preliminary assessments and the frozen hit-error training result. **The six 20k-event performance cases and final resolution/pull figures are still in progress.**

An independent 50,000-event Fatras gun (log-uniform pT 1–100 GeV, seed 142042) produced 699,273 measurements covering all 52 sensitive volumes. The unchanged ACTS `error_parameterisation.py` output is retained alongside an audited table: 106 cluster-size groups, 90 measured volume/coordinate pairs. The audit corrects the pinned script’s pooled-tail/overflow bookkeeping; no track-pull tuning or tail cuts are used. Both performance backends receive one frozen table.

Task-local native adapters correct truth measurement indexing/duplicate associations, preserve seven **unique** measurement selection, and apply trained marginal errors after native cluster merging. Native transport, clustered positions and the Kalman fitter remain unchanged. A persistent ordinary Geant4 run avoids repeated cut-table initialization while retaining one independent Geant4 event per ACTS event. Five same-seed events match the standard lifecycle exactly across generated particles, 95 hits, 80 measurements and fitted-track data.

- Governing prototype: DES-025; digitization contracts: DES-007/DES-008; source layout: ADR-008.
- Configuration and reproduction: `software/analysis/truth_tracking/README.md` and `campaign.json`.
- Training table, raw output, group audit and lifecycle comparison: `docs/validation/truth-tracking-baseline/`.
- Separate PhysVal has checked the initial metric definitions and exposed the upstream hit-error issue; exact native/training assessment is ongoing, with final six-run assessment still required.

The implementation reports generated denominators, missing/failed fits, invalid covariance, unclipped resolutions and pulls versus eta and pT. Fixed-map statistics omit training/model systematics. One-phi-bin material-map and locality qualifications from PR100 remain. **PROTOTYPE/DRAFT**: no detector design sign-off or production geometry change.

Also reconcile PR100’s merged metadata, final visible discussion and its now-finalized expert-response turn into that original account only. Tracking-baseline usage is a separate canonical account; active-turn counters remain excluded.

Closes #102.

issues.title: Tracker: establish the Gen3 truth-tracking performance baseline
issues.body:
Establish the first truth-associated tracking baseline for the PR100 Gen3 nODD tracker and its exact material map, as requested on 2026-10-26.

- Geant4 and Fatras; one muon per event at fixed pT 1, 10 and 100 GeV.
- Constant 3 T ideal field, selected by the human.
- Geometric 50×50 µm pixels, module-default 75 µm×0.5 mm short strips and 80 µm single-coordinate long strips on the physical stereo faces.
- Independent Fatras hit-error training using ACTS error_parameterisation.py, with auditable correction of its pooled-tail/overflow bookkeeping and one frozen table for both backends.
- Native truth-associated Kalman fits; generated denominators, unique measurements, failed fits and covariance failures retained.
- Perigee resolutions and pulls versus eta and pT, replayable figures/data, exact provenance and separate PhysVal assessment.

Implementation and evidence: PR #101. Governing prototype DES-025, module response DES-007/DES-008 and source layout ADR-008. This is a characterization campaign without detector design sign-off, reconstruction acceptance or production geometry changes.

Native build passed; my activated runtime tests passed **7/7**, digitization tests **6/6**. Coordinator independently confirmed **24 combined tests passed without skips**. Native source/binaries remained frozen throughout final production.

The read-only truth-matching investigation confirms exactly three fitted tracks have native unmatched sentinel barcodes:

- Fatras pT1: event 17622, fitted 11 of 23 primary measurements.
- Geant4 pT1: event 2129, fitted 3 of 20.
- Geant4 pT100: event 27, fitted 7 of 19.

All have one generated primary, matching selected primary barcode `(1,0,1,0,0)`, one candidate, one fitted track numbered 0, and native classification `Fake=3`. ACTS double matching requires ≥0.5 completeness; failure deliberately removes the optional truth ID, causing zero barcode and NaN writer truth. No nonzero incorrect barcodes occur in any final case. The proposed narrowly guarded association to the unique primary-derived proto track is supported by native scheduling and ROOT evidence; retain native unmatched counts separately.

The four Geant4 pT1 fit-loss events are **4059, 16435, 19129, 19186**. Their error categories are unavailable because pinned native code logs fit errors at DEBUG while production used WARNING. No reruns or tuning performed.

Retained controls establish:

- Standard/persistent Geant4 lifecycle payloads agree exactly across 210 branches.
- Removing the unsafe reference finder leaves all particle, measurement and track-summary branch payloads exactly equal for all three Fatras cases and completed Geant4 pT1.
- Failed initial Geant4 pT10/100 and all other historical controls remain explicitly excluded.

Comparison files are `native/lifecycle-equivalence.json` and `native/reference-removal-payload-check.json`. The independent 50k Fatras training sample and training observer-provenance qualification remain preserved. No further source/output changes were made during the final matching investigation.

events.text:
**TRUTH-PhysVal-01 preliminary assessment completed, read-only.** Reviewed nODD **`eb86998ad5d42c37bf7d244063c575f93b0c42a3`** and ACTS **`355ea68493b326956756c9386d2fd9eaf9328568`**. No files changed, no native execution, and no concurrent dirty implementation reviewed.

The pinned benchmark/reduction definitions are suitable for proceeding to production, conditional on correcting and auditing the hit-error table before use. This is a technical recommendation, without human acceptance.

**Findings**

1. **High: raw upstream hit-error JSON does not contain the claimed pooled-tail error.**  
   ACTS `Examples/Scripts/Digitization/error_parameterisation.py:153–158` computes and appends the exact-size population standard deviation. Lines `174–184` subsequently replace the selected residuals with the pooled `cluster_size >= c_size` residuals, but never recompute or replace the appended value. This can understate or overstate fitted measurement errors.

   I executed the exact pinned cluster loop, with plotting/file operations stubbed. For exact-size residual widths 1 and 4, the early-break JSON value is **1**, while the actual pooled width is **2.9154759474**.

2. **High: capped overflow and unsupported internal sizes need explicit handling.**  
   The same script’s `145–149` loop stops before `break_cluster_size`. With the default cap of 5, absent an earlier break, its last entry describes exact size 4. Native `GeometricConfig.cpp:20–24` applies the last entry to every size ≥4. That overflow group is not pooled by the script. An independent control returned exact-size **4**, whereas the actual pooled ≥4 width was **4.5276925691**. A missing internal cluster size produced **NaN** in the output vector.

3. **Required application check: a JSON table alone does not establish the fitted covariance.**  
   ACTS `Examples/Io/Json/src/JsonDigitizationConfig.cpp:201–212` squares JSON `"rms"` values. `ModuleClusters.cpp:291–325` later constructs geometric variances from cell weights and widths when merging, without retaining the earlier variance-map value. The DES-025 post-clustering adapter is consequently well motivated. Final assessment must verify actual written measurement variances equal **one square** of the frozen table lookup, including overflow and 1D measurements, while preserving positions, IDs and associations.

4. **Qualification: upstream `"rms"` actually means centered population standard deviation.**  
   The estimator is `np.std(res)`, not `sqrt(mean(res²))`. Preserve that convention if making a minimal repair, and record group means separately. It does not correct hit biases. A per-volume/cluster-size marginal table also omits incidence dependence and coordinate correlations; neither backend is guaranteed unit tracking pulls.

**Minimal auditable correction**

Retain the untouched ACTS script output, training ROOT input, source revision, configuration and hashes. For each measured volume/coordinate with raw vector length `K`, recompute groups `c < K` from exact cluster size and the final group from **all `c >= K`**. Record boundaries, counts, mean, centered population SD and uncentered RMS. Check finite positive widths; explicitly merge unsupported tails or report unsupported groups instead of inventing entries. Do not clip residuals or tune the table using performance outputs. Freeze one independently trained Fatras table for both simulation backends, and verify the post-clustering native covariance against it.

**Benchmark and observable checks**

| Requirement | Assessment |
|---|---|
| Both backends, 1/10/100 GeV pT, constant 3 T | Explicit in pinned campaign and DES-025. Native realization remains to be reviewed. |
| Origin perigee truth | Correct for the specified origin gun; non-origin vertices fail explicitly in `export_profiles.py:84–90`. Confirm final fitter target is the same origin perigee. |
| Phi residual | Correct shortest signed wrapping in `metrics.py:10–12,54–55`. |
| Derived pT pull | Correct unit-charge formula and theta–q/p cross term, including both charge signs (`metrics.py:60–69`). |
| Covariance failures | Finite, symmetric, positive-definite five-parameter covariance required for pulls; residuals retained independently. |
| Denominators | Generated-event alignment, exact barcodes, duplicate-track rejection, stage counts and explicit missing fits preserve all generated primaries. |
| Resolution and uncertainty | Unclipped sample SD, RMS, central 68.27% half-width, event bootstrap, null undersampled bins, and Wilson fraction intervals are consistent with stated definitions. |
| Plot coverage | Signed eta for all momenta/backends; pT in three displayed eta slices; all eight absolute-eta slices retained. Pull means and full widths are separate. |
| Training separation | Separate 50k Fatras training campaign and seed are specified. Actual frozen table identity and separation require final artifact verification. |

**Actual checks**

- All **7 pinned `test_metrics.py` tests passed**, loaded directly from the assigned Git objects.
- Independently checked the pT Jacobian by finite differences for positive and negative charge.
- Exercised pinned `summarize_bin` with six generated events: four selected, three attempts, two fitted tracks, one invalid covariance. It retained the correct **2/6** finite-fit denominator, one fit failure, two unselected events and missing pull estimates.
- Executed the three exact upstream-loop controls described above.
- Checked required particle and track-summary branches against pinned ACTS ROOT writers, including covariance branches requiring `writeCovMat`.
- Used existing analysis Python: NumPy **2.4.6**, pandas **2.3.3**.

The required Spack source preflight returned **unverified** because setup/lock fingerprints were stale or unreadable and full DD4hep/Geant4 sources were unverified. I inspected pinned ACTS Git objects without relying on those native dependencies.

The final six-run assessment remains outstanding: exact native source revision, geometry/map hashes, field consistency, measurement dimensionality, corrected truth association and deduplication, trained covariance realization, output provenance, numerical summaries and figure inspection. Bootstrap errors are conditional on the frozen table and do not include training or detector-model systematics.

events.text:
**TRUTH-PhysVal-02 completed, read-only**, at **`8b7254cfc36e1462088e7d390577a4a29dbf1075`**, with upstream ACTS **`355ea68493b326956756c9386d2fd9eaf9328568`**. No files changed, native reruns, builds, or nested agents.

**No blocking finding in the frozen error table or reviewed native contracts.** Proceeding to the separate six-run assessment is reasonable. This does not establish production performance or human acceptance.

- Independently recomputed **all 106 training groups** from **699,273 measurements**, using direct selections and `math.fsum` means/centered sums of squares, without importing `reconcile_table`.
- Counts, exact/tail boundaries, means, population SDs, uncentered RMS values and table entries all agree. Maximum SD/RMS difference: **2.78 × 10⁻¹⁷ mm**.
- Independently reproduced the complete raw ACTS table exactly, including its original exact-size-before-pooling behavior.
- Verified complete training ROOT SHA-256: **`57432af7115b3ec5a113ac3fd2d5a2f9c82cb187cd4cf8048c5b0504aa030cdc`**, plus raw/final table and training-report hashes.
- Table covers **52 volumes, 90 measured volume/coordinate pairs**, matching all **45,646** configured native sensors. Group counts range **3,346–44,400**; no unsupported-tail merge was needed.
- Largest correction is volume 38, loc1: raw **0.01020946 mm → pooled 0.03904524 mm**. This confirms the upstream defect materially affects this campaign.

**Actual lifecycle evidence passes.** I compared actual ROOT payloads, rather than relying on retained PASS text: **210 branches across five trees** agree exactly numerically, including NaNs, between standard and persistent modes:

| Tree | Entries |
|---|---:|
| Generated particles | 5 |
| Simulated hits | 95 |
| Measurements | 80 |
| Track summaries | 5 |
| Event audit | 5 |

All complete output hashes and source-report hashes match retained provenance.

**Source-contract assessment**

- `TruthTracking.cpp:119–149` performs one ordinary run initialization, one `ProcessOneEvent`/`TerminateOneEvent` pair per ACTS event, and run termination. It requires serial, single-event `BeamOn` calls. Upstream `Geant4Simulation.cpp:110–147` still resets the event store and reseeds immediately before every call; `nodd_truth_tracking.py:112–116` closes the persistent run in `finally`.
- `TruthTracking.cpp:30–64` uses the resolved sim-hit index directly, deduplicates physical measurement indices and sorts by hit time.
- `TruthTracking.cpp:151–169` deduplicates only measurement/particle pairs. Steering schedules this **before** native seven-measurement selection, proto-track creation and truth matching; the complete measurement/sim-hit map remains intact.
- `TruthTracking.cpp:73–108` clamps overflow to the final RMS entry, squares once, sets independent measured-coordinate marginal variances, and checks that copied positions, IDs and indices remain unchanged. The implementation supports actual 1D measurements.
- `digitization.py:26–65` retains requested pitches and one full-length second segmentation bin for long strips, while measuring only loc0. It adds no synthetic stereo coordinate.
- `material_runtime.py:106–149` reloads the exact keyed map; `PortalMaterial.cpp:135–145` clears original ACTS surface/volume slabs. Detailed Geant4 material remains in the separately constructed DD4hep detector.
- Steering uses the same constant **3 T** provider for transport and fitting, fixed transverse momentum for performance, and independently seeded log-uniform Fatras training.
- Native `TrackFittingAlgorithm.cpp:88–103` explicitly targets the origin perigee, consistent with the reducer’s origin truth.
- `export_profiles.py:51–88,103–113` checks every recorded measured marginal against the frozen table after exact ROOT dtype conversion. Its revised uncertainty wording correctly excludes training/model systematics.

**Qualifications to retain**

1. The five-event lifecycle comparison predates final association/covariance adapter changes and uses an older observer hash. It establishes the bounded lifecycle comparison for those recorded executables. Static review supports the current lifecycle contract; it is not a complete equivalence test of the final executable.
2. The training report explicitly states its observer/source hashes were collected after concurrent observer development, so they are **not an executed observer-binary identity**. The training positions were produced before downstream observer/tracking steps, without the fitted error table; the 106-group numerical audit remains valid. Exact training observer replay provenance remains qualified.
3. The table contains centered marginal SDs, without incidence conditioning or coordinate correlations. Training uncertainty and detector-model systematics remain omitted; unit tracking pulls are not an acceptance criterion.
4. Minor metadata wording: `nodd_truth_tracking.py:174–178` retains the default variance-description string even for calibrated runs. The explicit table hash, adapter and measurement audit identify the actual procedure; the final report should describe that procedure accurately.

Final calibrated covariance realization, all six performance outputs, denominators, summaries and figures remain for **TRUTH-PhysVal-03**.
